decisions.reason: Because the net price display plugin disappeared from the website soon after launch while several similar peripheral plugins were also discontinued, its market feedback appears to have resolved negatively and its limited strategic upside no longer justifies keeping the option open.

Because the ERP system interface plugin gained its own page after launch, fits closely with the firm's core shop-integration capabilities and future multichannel direction, and still offers scalable client value, it remains a worthwhile option to retain.
